calendar_status: Calendar planned against a tentative December 14, 2026 submission date supplied by the team. Alpha checkpoint: October 29–November 1. Weekly plan: November 2–December 13. Confirm the official deadline if it changes; preserve the final buffer week.
proposed_ownership: Kartik: procedural geometry, wind shaders, and profiling. Safa: UI/environment controls, asset review, and documentation. Both: integration, visual review, and regression testing.

weeks.engineering: Stabilize the alpha loop and environment controls; profile on a second desktop GPU/browser; prototype basic shadows within budget.
weeks.assets: Review existing soil, leaves, vein emission, and day/night palettes; correct readability and repetition defects.
weeks.integration: Retest start, growth, wind, lighting, finish, and restart together. Keep or defer shadows based on measured visual benefit and FPS.

weeks.engineering: Add a bounded movable light and controlled bending toward it; combine its deformation with wind without detaching organs.
weeks.assets: Create a small procedural light marker; tune color/range presets and check plant/light readability.
weeks.integration: Test simultaneous growth, wind, and light movement. Acceptance: repeatable seeds and five-plant limits still hold; lighting stays coherent.

weeks.engineering: Add constrained Crystal Bloom, Spiral Vine, and Glowing Tree rule presets; connect a species selector to seed generation.
weeks.assets: Build species-specific procedural leaves/petals and silhouettes; review palettes and record any new asset provenance.
weeks.integration: Run every family through the same growth/wind/render pipeline. Test bounds, five-plant mixed gardens, and reset cleanup.

weeks.engineering: Integrate species, wind, movable lighting, and shadows retained after profiling; exercise mixed five-plant gardens and long sessions.
weeks.assets: Resolve inconsistent silhouettes, materials, light markers, and UI labels across species; audit asset provenance.
weeks.integration: Produce a cross-feature test build. Acceptance: each family grows and sways coherently; no scene/light accumulation after repeated restart.

weeks.engineering: Complete cross-feature integration and performance pass; resolve high-priority defects; freeze feature scope at the end of this week.
weeks.assets: Finalize existing textures, palettes, and silhouettes; verify attribution and the consistency of all UI states.
weeks.integration: Publish a release candidate on Vercel and test two desktop browsers. Feature freeze December 6; defer unstable optional work before the freeze.

weeks.engineering: Bug fixes and regression checks only. Correct crashes, interaction defects, and performance regressions; no new features.
weeks.assets: Polish existing asset/UI defects only; prepare final screenshots and documentation. No new feature assets.
weeks.integration: Finalize README, PDF/release notes, and presentation/demo materials; verify hosted URL and restart flow. Submit on tentative December 14. No new features.
